about: Lists of values in code (`list<integer>`, `list<text>`, `list<decimal>`, `list<bool>`), as every runtime gives them. `xs[i]` reads or sets item i, counted from 1. A position outside the list fails with exactly `there is no item <i> in a list of <n>`. `random(max)` is an engine's, compiled to WebAssembly: see conformance/clarity-engines.json. `ranges`: `from to to` is the whole numbers from `from` to `to`, both counted, as a list; none when `to` is below `from`. `joins`: `join(texts, separator)` is the texts in order with the separator between each two; an empty list joins to empty text.

items.fails: there is no item 0 in a list of 3
there is no item 4 in a list of 3
there is no item 1 in a list of 0
there is no item -1 in a list of 3
